entries.sourceReference: Kiryu Kiwami2016 gray suit/burgundy shirt, physical Dragon of Dojima style. Direct and close combination are adapted physical actions, no canonical named Tiger Drop or magical dragon is asserted. Full45 special/chargeRelease depict the ordinary secondary Combinaison rapprochée de Kiryu; the distinct super Coup du Dragon de Dojima belongs to the dedicated32 presentation atlas.

normalization.method: Connected-alpha whole-pose segmentation; source-wide body calibration, one nearest-neighbor scale and one render factor per source; transparent packing.
normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive full-pose alpha bound; raised-arm ledge poses use separately measured palm attachment.
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; originals archived unchanged.

sourceStatureCalibration.reason: Complete native upright head-crown to shoe-sole body. One scale per source; all lower projections keep their native ratios.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default; native turn row3 begins left and ends right through two back-three-quarter keys.
visualValidation.outfit: Kiwami2016 Kiryu: short slicked-back black hair, light-gray business suit, open burgundy shirt, black belt, pale shoes, bare hands.
visualValidation.weapons: None. All punches, kicks and guard motions are physical bare hands/feet; no sword, bat, gun, magic dragon/tiger or aura body.
visualValidation.stature: 190px effective upright/hanging-body calibration. One pixel scale and render factor per source preserves true low poses and raised-arm proportions.
limitations: Original image-generated adapted choreography, not official source-game frames.
Small anatomical and costume proportion variation remains; exact source-game frame timings and pixels are not certified.
Ledge traversal is a gameplay adaptation; contact points are project measurements.
